q2: WITH ALL_PRODUCTS AS ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(PRODUCT_KEY ORDER BY PRODUCT_KEY) AS PRODUCTS FROM PRODUCT ), CUST_PRODUCTS AS ( SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT(PRODUCT_KEY) ORDER BY PRODUCT_KEY ASC) AS PRODUCTS FROM CUSTOMER GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID ) SELECT C.CUSTOMER_ID FROM CUST_PRODUCTS C JOIN ALL_PRODUCTS A ON A.PRODUCTS = C.PRODUCTS
